Title: Outlander
Actors: Caitríona Balfe, Sam Heughan, Sophie Skelton
Plot: Claire Beauchamp Randall, a nurse in World War II, mysteriously goes back in time to Scotland in 1743. There, she meets a dashing Highland warrior and gets drawn into an epic rebellion.
Awards: Nominated for 4 Primetime Emmys. 37 wins & 92 nominations total
